chapter.v:
This is
the vision that Isaiah, son of Amoz, saw about Judah and Jerusalem in the reigns of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah.

Heavens, listen!
Earth, pay attention! For the Lord has spoken! I brought up children, I cared for them, but they have rebelled against me.

An ox
knows its owner, and a donkey knows its feeding trough; but my people don't know me, they don't understand me.

What a
sinful nation—a people carrying such a load of guilt, an evil generation, corrupt children! They have abandoned the Lord. They have despised Israel's Holy One. They have become strangers. They have gone backwards.

Are you
wanting to be punished? Are you going to continue to rebel? The whole of your head is damaged, and your heart is totally giving out.

You're injured
from head to toe, bruised and sore, with open wounds that haven't been cleaned or bandaged or treated with olive oil.

Your country
has been devastated, your towns burned down, your fields stripped bare by foreigners right in front of you, as they turn it all into a wasteland.

The daughter
of Zion is left like a shack in a vineyard, like a hut in a cucumber field, like a city under attack.

If the
Lord Almighty hadn't let a few of us survive, we would have become like Sodom and Gomorrah.

Listen to
what the Lord has to say, you rulers of Sodom! Pay attention to the instructions of our God, you people of Gomorrah!

What use
are all your many sacrifices to me? asks the Lord. I am sick and tired of your burnt offerings of rams and the fat of sacrificial animals. I don't delight in the blood of bulls and lambs and goats!

When you
come to appear before me in worship, who asked you to proudly tramp around my courts?

Don't bring
me any more meaningless offerings; your incense is offensive to me. Your new moon festivals and Sabbath observations and your calling of special religious meetings—I can't stand them because they're evil, as are your solemn assemblies.

I detest
your new moon and yearly festivals with my whole being! They've become just a burden to me—I can't bear them anymore!

When you
hold up your hands to me in prayer, I'll look away. Even though you pray many prayers, I won't pay attention to them, because your hands are full of blood.

Wash yourselves
and clean yourselves up. Get rid of your sins—I don't want to see them! Stop doing evil!

Learn to
do good; strive for justice, condemn those who oppress others; support the rights of orphans, take up cases to defend widows.

Come on,
let's argue this out, says the Lord. Even though your sins are like scarlet, they will become white like snow. Even though they are red like crimson, they will become like wool.

If you
really want this, and if you do as you're told, then you yourselves will eat the best things that the land produces.

But if
you are defiant, and if you are rebellious, you'll be killed by the sword. This is what the Lord has declared!

The city
that used to be faithful has turned into a prostitute! Once she operated on principles of justice and followed what was right, but now only murderers live there.

Your silver
has become worthless waste; your wine has been watered down.

Your leaders
are rebels, friends of thieves. They all love bribes and want to get kickbacks. They don't defend the rights of orphans, and refuse to take cases to help widows.

So this
is what the Lord says, the Lord Almighty, the Mighty One of Israel: Ha! I will take satisfaction in punishing my enemies, by paying back those who hate me!

I will
turn against you. I will refine you in a furnace, removing all impurities.

I will
give you good leaders as you used to have before, wise counselors as you had in the beginning. After that you will once again be called the City of Integrity, the Faithful City.

Zion will
be rescued by justice, those who repent by doing right.

But rebels
and sinners will be destroyed together, and those who abandon the Lord will die.

You will
be ashamed about how you enjoyed your pagan worship among the oak trees; you will be embarrassed because you chose the pleasure gardens of idols.

As a
result you will become like an oak whose leaves have withered, a dried-out garden that has no water.

Your strong
people will become like tinder, and their work will become like a spark. They will burn together, and nobody will be able to put out the flames.
